name: Falkirk Open 2026
information:
Everyone is welcome to compete in this competition, and all competitors are eligible to win medals for podium positions. However, if you are a newer competitor, you may be more interested in the [Falkirk Beginners 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FalkirkBeginners2026) competition. 

PLEASE NOTE: This is a Series Competition with [Falkirk Beginners 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FalkirkBeginners2026). You may only attend ONE of these competitions. Please see further details on the [Series Competition tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FalkirkOpen2026#66384-series-competition-information).

Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**

### Falkirk Science Festival 2026

This competition is taking place with the kind support of the [Falkirk Science Festival](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FalkirkOpen2026#66387-falkirk-science-festival-2026).
